chunks: And when the ten-month pregnant female camels are abandoned
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about pregnant camels on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'ten-month pregnant camels' (Al-Ishar) symbolize the peak of worldly utility and value, whose abandonment signifies the total collapse of economic and social order during the Great Conflagration. This imagery underscores the transient nature of material wealth, a key theme in Surah Al-Infitar, pointing to the ultimate return to the Divine where all worldly attachments are rendered obsolete.
